x-ecosystem-packaging.adapterIsolation: src/adapter.js is the only module that talks to the DSH llm service; it imports nothing from @deepseek-ai/*.
x-ecosystem-packaging.runtime: Both keyless lanes are reached directly over HTTPS from the plugin process; there is no runtime download, child process or local port. The free lane's v2 wire contract is carried verbatim in src/o2a/ from dsh-our-free-model (MIT).
